gloss: storefront; in front of a shop

definitions.gloss: storefront; in front of a shop; shop front area
definitions.explanation: The area directly in front of or at the entrance of a shop, including any outdoor display space.

examples.japanese: {店先|みせさき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{並|なら}んでいる→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧。
examples.english: Flowers are lined up in front of the shop.

examples.japanese: {店先|みせさき}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{野菜|やさい}→野菜：02265_yasai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{売|う}っている→売る：00906_uru⟧。
examples.english: They sell vegetables at the storefront.

examples.japanese: ⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{降|ふ}って→降る：00839_furu⟧きた⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、{店先|みせさき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{軒下|のきした}→軒下：07850_nokishita⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{雨宿|あまやど}り→雨宿り：14929_amayadori⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: When it started raining, I took shelter under the eaves of a shop front.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧ (shop) + ⟦{先|さき}→先：02883_saki⟧ (front/ahead). Refers to the area immediately in front of or at the entrance of a shop, often where goods are displayed outdoors.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {店先|みせさき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{並|なら}べる→並べる：01091_naraberu⟧: to display in front of a shop
- {店先|みせさき}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{売|う}る→売る：00906_uru⟧: to sell at the storefront
- {店先|みせさき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立|た}つ→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧: to stand at the shop front
- {店先|みせさき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{看板|かんばん}→看板：00166_kanban⟧: a sign at the shop front

USAGE:
Evokes a traditional or small-business atmosphere — fruit stands, flower shops, and local stores that display goods outside. Less commonly used for modern chain stores or malls.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{店頭|てんとう}→店頭：12488_tentou⟧: shop front, over the counter — more formal; often used in business/financial contexts ({店頭販売|てんとうはんばい}, over-the-counter sales)
- ⟦{軒先|のきさき}→軒先：08402_nokisaki⟧: under the eaves — specifically the area under the roof overhang, not the full storefront
